name: Bjorn Lindström
bio: Bjorn's journey into motorsport began in his early teens, captivated by the engineering intricacies of Formula 1 cars. He spent countless hours disassembling and reassembling engines in his father's workshop, developing a deep understanding of mechanical systems. This passion led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, Bjorn joined a smaller racing outfit where he quickly rose through the ranks, proving his ability to optimize car performance and lead technical teams. He believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing telemetry and pushing the boundaries of innovation. His ability to adapt quickly to changing conditions and inspire his team sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight fade.
physical.description: Bjorn is a lean man with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on wearing noise-canceling headphones in the garage to maintain focus.
